description: This file defines a class 'HTMLPurifier_AttrDef_URI_IPv4' responsible for validating IPv4 addresses within a larger HTML purification library. It includes methods for validation and regex management.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_AttrDef_URI_IPv4
classes.description: A class that validates IPv4 addresses, extending HTMLPurifier_AttrDef.
